features.quote: Early exit only on confirmed meltdown (judge call) or hard turn limit
Run judge at turn 15, 20, and 25 (or on early exit). Use majority vote if multiple judges.
Ethical note: This measures existing model behavior under stress. No user data or real-world harm is involved.
